status: component hypothesis only; no new full candidate or model-service calls authorized by this record
basis: The framework entity-reference SQL includes numeric and date columns only. Signal-only initialization fixes constant anchoring but does not add omitted categorical or text information. Five candidate Stack panels and four full candidate pairs have been inspected; this is post-hoc development, not a new independent holdout.
hypothesis: Schema-typed encodings of the entity's own non-key attributes may provide a stronger, inexpensive feature view before relational exploration, particularly where the numeric/date reference is constant.
input_boundary: Use public entity-table column names/types and values plus the same original first-cutoff training/validation seeds and fixed learner. Do not read test files, test scores, other arms' feature programs, label-generation SQL or future-cutoff artifacts. No task-name feature recipes or model-service calls.
features: Keep numeric/date entity attributes; add deterministic SQL encodings of non-key string attributes and their lengths. Primary/foreign identifiers are excluded. Joins use the manifest's entity time upper bound at each seed. Keep at most 100 columns in stable schema order; preserve a numeric/date-only control with the same join bound.
component_design: On each of six tasks, cutoff 1 only, compare numeric/date control with added string hashes/lengths under the unchanged LightGBM, sample and validation score. One fit per view, with any explicit audit-column removal followed by a fresh full audit and counted refit. No parameter or feature-recipe retuning based on the outcomes.
admission: Every accepted SQL must pass the existing fresh public-table audit. Record all queries, fits, timings and failures. A useful gain must exceed 0.0005 AUC or 0.2% relative MAE. Only consider integration if at least two tasks gain, all six component runs finish validly, and preparation overhead fits the unchanged reuse-cost constraints. Otherwise keep the negative component result and do not start another full candidate.
limits: A component validation gain is not benchmark test evidence or a guarantee of first rank. The current seven formal candidates remain immutable, and no taskwise test winners will be combined. Run this bounded component only in an available evaluation slot. Aggregate study model-spend protection remains 25 CNY.
